messages:
Priya (CS): Hey team — Cascade Health asked for a short-term config change ahead of their executive demo tomorrow. They need their IPs whitelisted in eu-west-1 and a temporary rate window increase for ingestion endpoints. Can infra + security approve?

Sam (Support): +1. Customer onboarding flagged this as high priority. Demo starts 10:00 CET. They expect a 3x burst for 2 hours then steady traffic. Account: cascade-health / acct_0452.

Oliver (Eng Infra): Can you paste the IP ranges and exact rate numbers? We prefer using a scoped policy instead of a global change. Also need duration.

Priya (CS): IPs: 54.210.34.0/24 and 3.120.88.128/25. Current ingestion rate: 200 requests/min per api_key. Requested: temp window to 600 requests/min per api_key for 6 hours (10:00-16:00 CET to be safe). Will revert automatically after window.

Aisha (Security): Quick check: those CIDRs look like Cascade's cloud egress. We need an approved justification + PO reference in the ticket before I sign off. Also prefer adding to a customer-scoped allowlist entry.

Priya (CS): PO# CH-2026-04 included in ticket #CS-7182. Justification: demo + load test for rollout. Adding here for record.

Oliver (Eng Infra): OK. I'll create a scoped ACL and a rate-window override. Deploying via admin API. Patch I will run:```curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/allowlists \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_0452","name":"cascade-temp-eu","cidrs":["54.210.34.0/24","3.120.88.128/25"],"expires_at":"2026-06-07T16:00:00Z"}'

curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/rate-overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_0452","route":"/v1/ingest","limit_per_min":600,"scope":"account","expires_at":"2026-06-07T16:00:00Z","reason":"Demo + load test"}'
```

cascade-bot: Created ticket CS-7182-update by Oliver. Change flagged for manual security review.

Aisha (Security): I reviewed the PO and the CIDRs. Approve for scoped ACL with strict expire timestamp. Add logging to the rollout and alert if 95th percentile latency > 600ms for ingestion route.

Oliver (Eng Infra): Will add a short-lived log hook and an alert rule. Will schedule rollout at 09:30 CET for a 10:00 switch. I will post a confirmation when live.

Sam (Support): Noted. I'll message the customer with the final window and escalation path. Priya — can you follow up with the customer to confirm they will limit the initial burst to 5k concurrent requests?

Priya (CS): Yep, messaging now.

Oliver (Eng Infra): Done. ACL and rate override applied. Changes: allowlist id alw_9823, override id ro_5567. Expires: 2026-06-07T16:00:00Z. Test curl to verify token-scoped route works:```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <customer-key>" https://eu-west-1.api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -d '{"ping":1}'```

Priya (CS): Customer confirmed burst cap and will follow rollback plan. Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved and will close CS-7182 after expiry. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Support): Adding note to renewal risk tracker — positive engagement, demo looks like a potential upsell. Logged under Q3 renewals.

cascade-bot: Ticket CS-7182 scheduled for auto-expiry 2026-06-07T16:00:00Z.
